text: The eyes of the Happy Prince were filled with tears, and tears were running down his golden cheeks. His face was so beautiful in the moonlight that the little Swallow was filled with pity. “Who are you?” he said. “I am the Happy Prince.” “Why are you weeping then?” asked the Swallow; “you have quite drenched me.” “When I was alive and had a human heart,” answered the statue, “I did not know what tears were, for I lived in the Palace of Sans-Souci, where sorrow is not allowed to enter. In the daytime I played with my companions in the garden, and in the evening I led the dance in the Great Hall. Round the garden ran a very lofty wall, but I never cared to ask what lay beyond it, everything about me was so beautiful. My courtiers called me the Happy Prince, and happy indeed I was, if pleasure be happiness. So I lived, and so I died. And now that I am dead they have set me up here so high that I can see all the ugliness and all the misery of my city, and though my heart is made of lead yet I cannot chose but weep.” “What! is he not solid gold?” said the Swallow to himself. He was too polite to make any personal remarks out loud.
title: The Happy Prince Weeps
director_note: The prince weeps on his high column as the swallow, enlarged into view, looks up in pity and questions his golden sorrow. The staging keeps the swallow at the prince's side while the long speech carries memory and misery without crowding the frame.

layers.name: sky
layers.code: var g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H); g.addColorStop(0,'#1B2340'); g.addColorStop(0.5,'#2a1f4e'); g.addColorStop(1,'#3a2a5a'); ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(-30,0,450,H); /* large colour bands to fragment flat sky */ var bands=['rgba(42,31,78,0.5)','rgba(27,35,64,0.45)','rgba(58,42,90,0.4)','rgba(24,18,48,0.5)','rgba(212,175,55,0.08)','rgba(60,40,95,0.35)']; for(var i=0;i<12;i++){ctx.fillStyle=bands[i%bands.length]; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-30+rand()*450, rand()*H, 120+rand()*120, 30+rand()*40, rand()*0.7, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();} /* speckle */ var pal=['#1B2340','#2a1f4e','#3a2a5a','#241a40','#32245a','#1a2038']; for(var i=0;i<3000;i++){ctx.fillStyle=pal[i%pal.length]; ctx.globalAlpha=0.2+ (i%9)*0.03; ctx.fillRect(-30+rand()*450,rand()*H,1+rand()*3,1+rand()*3);} ctx.globalAlpha=1; /* moon */ ctx.fillStyle='#F4E7D0'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(300,90,52,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(244,231,208,0.18)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(300,90,86,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(244,231,208,0.08)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(300,90,120,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); /* moon craters */ ctx.fillStyle='rgba(27,35,64,0.25)'; for(var i=0;i<8;i++){ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(300-20+rand()*40,90-20+rand()*40,2+rand()*4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();} /* clouds */ ctx.fillStyle='rgba(244,231,208,0.22)'; for(var i=0;i<12;i++){var cx=-30+rand()*450; var cy=20+rand()*160; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,25+rand()*45,5+rand()*9,rand()*0.6,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();} /* stars dense */ ctx.fillStyle='#F4E7D0'; for(var i=0;i<260;i++){var x=-30+rand()*450; var y=rand()*300; var r=0.4+rand()*1.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();} /* horizon glow */ var hg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,H-140,0,H); hg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(212,175,55,0.0)'); hg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(212,175,55,0.22)'); ctx.fillStyle=hg; ctx.fillRect(-30,H-140,450,140); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(212,175,55,0.12)'; for(var i=0;i<80;i++){ctx.fillRect(-30+rand()*450,H-70+rand()*50,2+rand()*3,1+rand()*2);}

layers.code: for(var i=0;i<18;i++){var x=-30+((i*73)%450); var y=20+(i*37)%260; var a=0.3+0.7*(0.5+0.5*Math.sin(t*2+i*0.9)); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(244,231,208,'+a+')'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,1.2+ (i%3)*0.4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();} /* drifting cloud wisps */ ctx.fillStyle='rgba(244,231,208,0.12)'; for(var i=0;i<4;i++){var cx=(-40 + (t*8 + i*110)%520); var cy=60+i*25; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,50,9,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();}

layers.name: far_city
layers.code: /* distant rooftops silhouette */ ctx.fillStyle='#1B2340'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-30,H); for(var x=-30;x<=420;x+=6){var h=H-90 - (Math.sin(x*0.05)*18) - (x%47<12?22:0); ctx.lineTo(x,h);} ctx.lineTo(420,H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); /* warm window dots */ ctx.fillStyle='#D4AF37'; for(var i=0;i<70;i++){var wx=-20+rand()*440; var wy=H-110+rand()*25; ctx.fillRect(wx,wy,2,2);} /* spires */ ctx.fillStyle='#1B2340'; for(var i=0;i<9;i++){var sx=-10+i*48; var sy=H-115-Math.random()*30; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx,sy); ctx.lineTo(sx+6,sy-24); ctx.lineTo(sx+12,sy); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();}

layers.code: /* left framing ivy */ ctx.fillStyle='#2a4a2a'; for(var i=0;i<40;i++){var x=-30+rand()*60; var y=120+rand()*380; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,y,6+rand()*6,4+rand()*4,rand()*Math.PI,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();} /* leaves */ ctx.fillStyle='#3a6a3a'; for(var i=0;i<60;i++){var x=-30+rand()*75; var y=130+rand()*360; ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.rotate(rand()*Math.PI); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,8+rand()*6,3+rand()*3,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();} /* right framing */ ctx.fillStyle='#2a4a2a'; for(var i=0;i<40;i++){var x=330+rand()*90; var y=120+rand()*380; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,y,6+rand()*6,4+rand()*4,rand()*Math.PI,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();} ctx.fillStyle='#3a6a3a'; for(var i=0;i<60;i++){var x=325+rand()*95; var y=130+rand()*360; ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.rotate(rand()*Math.PI); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,8+rand()*6,3+rand()*3,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();} /* bottom corner leaves */ ctx.fillStyle='#A62C2C'; for(var i=0;i<18;i++){var x= (i<9)?(-30+rand()*60):(330+rand()*90); var y=470+rand()*50; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,3+rand()*4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();}

layers.name: cloud_bank
layers.code: /* large varied cloud banks to break sky flatness */ var shades=['rgba(244,231,208,0.18)','rgba(212,175,55,0.12)','rgba(42,31,78,0.35)','rgba(58,42,90,0.28)','rgba(27,35,64,0.3)','rgba(244,231,208,0.10)']; for(var i=0;i<28;i++){ctx.fillStyle=shades[i%shades.length]; var cx=-30+rand()*450; var cy=20+rand()*300; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,40+rand()*70,12+rand()*28,rand()*0.8,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();} /* streaks */ ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(244,231,208,0.08)'; ctx.lineWidth=2; for(var i=0;i<20;i++){ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-30+rand()*450,rand()*320); ctx.lineTo(-30+rand()*450,rand()*320); ctx.stroke();} /* distant bright star clusters */ ctx.fillStyle='rgba(212,175,55,0.35)'; for(var i=0;i<30;i++){ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-30+rand()*450,rand()*320,2+rand()*3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();}
